Suspects in Paris Rugby Star Murder Ask Forgiveness Ahead of Verdict

In a Paris court on Friday, Loik Le Priol, a primary suspect in the 2022 murder of Argentine rugby player Federico Martin Aramburu, requested forgiveness from the victim's family. Verdicts are expected for four suspects, including Le Priol and Romain Bouvier, who are reported to have links to France's far-right.
